metadata.name: hookpool
metadata.description: hookpool: constant-product AMM with pool-level hooks on Solana

instructions.name: approve_hook
docs: Admin: puts a frozen hook program on the approved list. While
`Platform::hook_approval_required` is on, only listed programs (and the platform's own
hooks) can open a pool. The admin pays the rent of the platform account's growth.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays the rent of the platform account's growth by one entry.

instructions.name: collect_hook_fees
docs: Pays the hook fees that waited for a closed treasury. Anyone may call it.

instructions.name: create_curve_pool
docs: A pool on the curve: the whole supply of the coin and no quote at all. It prices
trades with the platform's virtual quote on top of its real reserve, pays out the
real reserve only, refuses liquidity until it graduates, and locks all of its LP.
The same accounts as `create_pool`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the new accounts.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owns the source token accounts, receives the LP tokens, recorded as creator.

accounts.name: hook_caller
docs: Holds no data.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the new accounts.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owns the source token accounts, receives the LP tokens, recorded as creator.

accounts.name: hook_caller
docs: Holds no data.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Permissionless: once a pool on the curve holds its graduation target in real quote,
drop the virtual quote, take the platform's share, and burn the coins that the
virtual quote stood for, so that the price does not move.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Writable: the burn lowers the coin's supply.

instructions.name: hook_buy_burn
docs: A buy started by the pool's hook whose coins are burned in the pool's vault and
never transferred. Who may call it, the price and the fees are those of
`hook_swap` in the buy direction. (Added after every other instruction, so that
nothing before it moves.)

accounts.name: hook_authority
docs: PDA ["hook-authority", pool] of the pool's hook program.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Writable: the burn lowers the coin's supply.

accounts.name: hook_quote
docs: The hook's own quote account: what the buy is paid from.

instructions.name: hook_swap
docs: Same as `swap`, started by the pool's hook. No callbacks, no hook fee.

accounts.name: hook_authority
docs: PDA ["hook-authority", pool] of the pool's hook program.

instructions.name: revoke_hook
docs: Admin: takes a program off the approved list. Pools already on it are not touched.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives the rent the shorter platform account no longer needs.

instructions.name: swap
docs: direction: 0 = buy (quote in, base out), 1 = sell (base in, quote out). Exact input.

accounts.name: user_base
docs: The token accounts of the trade: one is spent, the other receives. The token
program checks that `user` may spend the account the coins leave (its owner, or a
delegate). The account that receives may belong to anyone, so an aggregator or a
bot can sign with one wallet and pay out to another. Never the pool's own vault.

accounts.name: hook_quote_treasury
docs: hook fee get any writable account here (clients pass the user's quote account).

accounts.name: hook_caller
docs: One address per hook program, so that no hook can pass the pool's signature on to
another hook. For a pool without a hook it is the address of the system program
(the `hook_program` clients pass then) and signs nothing.

types.name: CreateCurvePoolArgs
docs: A pool on the curve: no quote amount, the real quote reserve starts at 0.

types.name: CurveOpened
docs: A pool opened on the curve (right after its `PoolCreated`): the settings it was given.

types.name: Graduated
docs: A pool graduated: the virtual quote is gone, the fee left the reserve, and enough coins
were burned from the vault to keep the price.

types.name: HookApprovalChanged
docs: A hook program was put on the approved list (`approved`) or taken off it. `count` is the
length of the list after the change.

types.name: HookApprovalRequiredChanged
docs: The approved-list rule was switched on or off.

types.name: HookFeesCollected
docs: Hook fees that had waited for a closed treasury were paid to it.

fields.name: curve_virtual_quote
docs: The curve launch (HOOKS.md section 2): the quote counted in the price of a new curve
pool without being there, and the real quote reserve at which it graduates. Copied
into each curve pool at creation; a later change does not touch running curves.
Either one at 0 switches curve launches off (`CurveDisabled`).

fields.name: curve_graduation_fee_bps
docs: Share of the target taken for the platform at graduation, at most
`HARD_MAX_GRADUATION_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: hook_approval_required
docs: When true, a hook that is not the platform's own (HOOK_KIND_FROZEN) opens a pool
only when its program is on the approved list kept after this account's fixed part
(HOOKS.md section 6.1, `crate::approvals`). Taken from the first reserved byte, so a
platform written before it existed reads false: nothing changes until the admin
turns it on.

types.name: Pool
docs: The pool account. All fields live in the shared `PoolData` so hooks can read
them with the interface crate alone. `Deref` keeps `pool.reserve_base` ergonomic.

fields.name: hook_fees_quote_total
docs: Hook fees charged so far, paid or still owed.

fields.name: hook_fees_owed_quote
docs: Hook fees charged while the treasury account did not exist. They wait in the quote
vault, outside the reserves, and are paid by the next swap that finds the treasury
or by `collect_hook_fees`.

fields.name: hook_treasury_owner
docs: The wallet whose associated token account the hook treasury is, so that anyone can
recreate that account. All zeros when the hook takes no fee.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Quote counted in the price while the pool is on the curve, and not in the vault:
the price is `(reserve_quote + virtual_quote) / reserve_base`, a sell is paid from
`reserve_quote` alone. 0 on a seeded pool and after graduation.

fields.name: graduation_target
docs: The real quote reserve at which `graduate` is allowed. 0 on a seeded pool and
after graduation.

fields.name: graduation_fee_bps
docs: Share of the target, in basis points, that graduation takes for the platform.

fields.name: curve_state
docs: `CURVE_NONE`, `CURVE_OPEN` or `CURVE_GRADUATED`.

types.name: UpdatePlatformArgs
docs: Every field is optional: `None` leaves the setting as it is. The curve launch's three
and then `hook_approval_required` were appended later; an encoding that ends before
them, as the earlier clients wrote it, is read as leaving them unchanged.

fields.name: curve_virtual_quote
docs: The curve launch. A virtual quote or a target of 0 switches curve launches off.

fields.name: curve_graduation_fee_bps
docs: At most `HARD_MAX_GRADUATION_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: hook_approval_required
docs: The approved-list rule (HOOKS.md section 6.1).
